people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

translations.web: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
translations.bsb: The single day appointed throughout all the provinces of King Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
translations.kjv: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
